name: program-landscape
description: KKU Curriculum Intelligence Platform · Program Landscape — strategic decision-support for the University Council

scripts.setup: pnpm install && node scripts/link-env.mjs && pnpm db:up && pnpm minio:init && pnpm db:migrate && pnpm db:seed
scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api,ingest -c blue,green,magenta "pnpm --filter web dev" "pnpm --filter api start:dev" "pnpm --filter ingestion start:dev"
scripts.db:up: docker compose up -d postgres redis minio gotenberg
scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && pnpm db:up && pnpm minio:init && pnpm db:migrate && pnpm db:seed
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test
